title: SEC4: backup_progress callback lacks documentation
description:
Function backup_progress (lines 7-13, backup.rs) is private but undocumented:
- References 'pagecount' and 'remaining' from SQLite's backup API without explanation
- A maintainer unfamiliar with SQLite internals won't understand what 'pages' means
- The eprint! format string has no comment explaining the output

SUGGESTION: Add a doc comment above backup_progress like:
  /// Progress callback for SQLite backup. 'pages' are SQLite internal chunks.
  /// This prints live progress in the form 'Backing up... N/M pages'.
